normal_orientation_method: All source meshes run bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals before export; reimported loop normals must be finite/unit; per-object signed volume is authoritative for this union of solids; 31,500 deterministic visibility rays test the first visible face from nine interior targets, with a 0.15% residual allowed at coincident faces.
origin_convention: Local Z = 0 is the TOP OF THE PIER DECK, not the model's lowest point. placeGeneric() seats the origin on one terrain sample at the anchor and the app's DEM carries this pier as a ~2.5 m ridge, so a model sitting on z = 0 would float 2.6 m above its own deck. The deck fascia and pile stubs therefore run to z = -2.6 m and min_z_m is NEGATIVE BY DESIGN. See docs/asset-plans/pier-9.md 2.3.
